name: Quorum

categories.label: Africa province
categories.hint: Counted: cards with power 1 in your play zone. Rank 1 = full influence token value, rank 2 = value minus 1, etc. Rank 0 if you never advanced here.

categories.label: Asia province
categories.hint: Counted: cards with power 2 in your play zone. Rank 1 = full influence token value, rank 2 = value minus 1, etc. Rank 0 if you never advanced here.

categories.label: Germania province
categories.hint: Counted: Intrigue cards in your play zone. Rank 1 = full influence token value, rank 2 = value minus 1, etc. Rank 0 if you never advanced here.

categories.label: Gallia province
categories.hint: Counted: Military cards in your play zone. Rank 1 = full influence token value, rank 2 = value minus 1, etc. Rank 0 if you never advanced here.

categories.label: Hispania province
categories.hint: Counted: Trade cards in your play zone. Rank 1 = full influence token value, rank 2 = value minus 1, etc. Rank 0 if you never advanced here.

categories.label: Macedonia province
categories.hint: Counted: Architecture cards in your play zone. Rank 1 = full influence token value, rank 2 = value minus 1, etc. Rank 0 if you never advanced here.

categories.label: Military cards
categories.hint: 5 per pair of consecutive power values; 10 per 1-2-3 trio (a trio scores 10 only).

categories.label: Trade cards
categories.hint: Per product type: 2 matching = 2, 3 = 4, 4+ = 6; single products score 0.

categories.label: Intrigue cards
categories.hint: Intrigue cards x cards with power 3 in your play zone.

categories.label: Total province influence
categories.hint: Tiebreaker only: higher total province advancement wins.

tiebreakers.description: If still tied, victory is shared.

notes: family: point-salad-euro. 12 turns, everything scores at the end. Province scoring in order Africa, Asia, Germania, Gallia, Hispania, Macedonia: first-ranked player multiplies the relevant card count by the province's influence token (1-4, modified by God cards); second-ranked uses token minus 1; only players who advanced at least one space score; same-space ties favour the lower marker. Sources disagree whether 3rd/4th rank continue down (floor 0): the formula allows it, enter rank 0 for non-scoring players. Not verified against the official Devir rulebook PDF (not downloadable); based on detailed reviews. Military trio vs pairs interaction per the review's example (trio = 10, not 10 plus pairs).
